Rogamos ser puntuales al momento de inscribirse como tambien al momento de realizar el pago de su respectivba inscripcion, NO HABRA TOLERANCIA PARA PAGOS IMPUNTUALES. Si tienes alguna duda acerca de como inscribirse puedes comunicarte con los numeros de contacto. Conozca las [regulaciones de WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) ya que este es un torneo oficial. Know the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) since this is an official tournament.

items.name: West LA Winter 2020
items.information: Please be at the competition 15 minutes prior to when your events are due to start. Pets and alcoholic beverages are not allowed inside the venue. **Please remember to refrain from flash photography.** The sequel to West LA Spring 2019, this competition is a fundraiser for Hamilton High School's engineering club The da Vinci Coders and the various activities and challenges they compete in, including the JPL Invention Challenge and the FIRST Robotics Competition (Team 5510). All proceeds will be donated to the club to support their STEM endeavors. Please consider donating if you so wish - it is not mandatory, but any donations are greatly appreciated! To learn more about The da Vinci Coders, you can visit their website [here](https://www.thedavincicoders.org/).
